messages.subject: Rewriting R plot in ggplot2
parts:
Dear ggplot2 users,

I have created the following plot in R;

tmp <- hist(Table[,9], breaks = c(1, 2, 4, 6, 10, 420), plot = FALSE)
plot.new()
plot(tmp$counts/sum(tmp$counts), type = 'b', axes = FALSE, ylim = c(0, 0.45), xlim = c(0.5, 5.5))

axis(1, at = seq(0.5, 6, by = 1), labels = FALSE)
axis(1, at = seq(1, 5, by = 1), labels = c("1 - 2", "2 - 4", "4 - 6", "6 - 10", "10 - 420"), tick = FALSE)
axis(2)

(shown in the attached jpg). I would like to do the same thing but with ggplot (to make it more visual pleasing), but can't seem to
find the set of command to do exactly the same plot. could someone help me with this?

Thanks,
Maria
